vehicle: 1996 Honda Civic DX hatchback EV conversion

source_note.role: historical user planning; current BRAKES.md supersedes conflicting assumptions

confirmed_by_user.front_brakes: stock DX size; not physically measured

selection.rotors: 294 mm R53 Mini Cooper S JCW; supplier references Centric 125.34092 / DBA2524 / RDA7974
selection.likely_knuckle_path: Honed small-hub 242 mm/9.5 inch kit, pending rotor/hub measurement; some matching small Honda rotor catalogues state 240 mm
selection.alternative: HDP23-01 262 mm kit only if actual large knuckles are present
selection.master_cylinder: retain as inspection/calculation baseline, final bore and compatibility unresolved
selection.hard_lines: retain serviceable compatible original lines; no automatic diameter increase
selection.flex_hoses: budget correct replacement front hoses; verify inlet adapters, full-lock and suspension-travel slack
selection.assist: retain suitable vacuum booster with standalone-rated electric vacuum supply; exact pump/control not selected
selection.rear_conversion: Planned 1994-2001 Integra DC2/DC4 non-Type-R 4x100 rear-disc assemblies; exact donor, cables and hydraulic match pending

price_observations.item: HELLA UP30 009286001 pump only; sourcing reference, not approved assembly

bom.item: Correct Honed mounting kit; select ONE knuckle version
bom.basis: rounded observed USD kit prices; brackets, mounting hardware and hose adapters included; small-hub kit includes centering rings

bom.item: Used serviceable 986 base FRONT calipers
bom.basis: planning allowance; no donor pair quoted; new genuine calipers excluded

bom.item: Seal/boot and pad-retaining service parts for both calipers
bom.basis: allowance; replacement pistons/crossover pipes or professional rebuilding extra if needed

bom.item: Matching front pad set, compound to be selected
bom.basis: allowance; supplier references observed separately, not a binding quote

bom.item: Compatible 294 mm JCW rotors
bom.basis: allowance; confirm exact manufacturer specification, not generic Mini fitment

bom.item: Correct conversion-compatible front flexible hoses
bom.basis: allowance; supplier permits suitable existing hoses, but age/slack/condition must be checked

bom.item: Compatible fresh brake fluid for flush/bleed
bom.basis: allowance; fluid type and quantity follow actual hydraulic-system specification

bom.item: Cleaning, caps and minor service consumables
bom.basis: allowance; included kit hardware/washers not charged twice

bom.item: Standalone-rated electric brake-vacuum pump
bom.basis: allowance anchored by UP30 pump-only listing; exact system not selected

bom.item: Vacuum reservoir, check valve and vacuum-rated hose
bom.basis: allowance; size for actual booster and reserve requirement

bom.item: Vacuum sensor/switch, demand control and low-vacuum warning
bom.basis: allowance; independent brake-assist control, thresholds unassigned

bom.item: Fused LV wiring, relay/driver, connector and mounts
bom.basis: allowance; exact fuse and wiring ratings remain pump dependent

bom.item: Installation, bleed and basic validation labor
bom.basis: engineering allowance, not a shop quote; certification and test-venue fees excluded

bom.basis: Engineering allowance, not a quote. Credit included donor parts; do not count complete assemblies and replacements twice.

conditional_allowances_usd.item: Matched master cylinder if assessment requires replacement
Spacers and longer studs if verified appropriate
Replacement wheel set if needed, excluding tires
Front knuckle/hub/bearing changes only if axle or inspected fitment requires
Replacement caliper piston set if inspection requires
Rear hub/bearing pair if donor hubs fail inspection

exclusions: shipping, sales tax and import charges
release_gates: Integra rear-disc donor/parking-cable/hydraulic matching and converted axle-load/bias review
master bore, piston/wheel-cylinder areas, pedal travel and pressure reviewed
vacuum assist and loss-of-supply behavior verified
hydraulic and regen-unavailable stop/fade/bias tests completed
supplier race-use restriction and road-use acceptability resolved
